name: forgekit-studio-monorepo
description: ForgeKit Studio monorepo: web project builder, generator core library, CLI and template catalog.

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @forgekit/templates build && pnpm --filter @forgekit/core build && pnpm --filter forgekit-studio dev
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @forgekit/templates build && pnpm --filter @forgekit/core build && pnpm -r typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @forgekit/templates build && pnpm --filter @forgekit/core build && pnpm -r --if-present test
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
